text:
emma_cs: Morning  Sunrise Analytics pilot posted a short feedback bundle after onboarding week 1. Can product triage so CS can update renewal guidance?

emma_cs: Copied their asks (condensed):
```
1) Per-campaign cost allocation in billing exports (finance needs campaign-level invoice lines)
2) Org-level embeddings bulk dump (data team automation)
3) Air-gapped nightly agent sync (on-prem compliance)
4) Onboarding checklist / first-run wizard in Console (reduce support)
5) Minimum-per-route billing alerts (prevent surprise bills)
```

ryan_pm: Which are blockers for their pilot/renewal?

emma_cs: #1 and #3 are blockers; #5 is a risk-mitigator they'd like; #2 and #4 are helpful but not blocking. Renewal in ~4 weeks and procurement asked for billing detail now. :rotating_light:

zoe_prod: Quick impact notes: #1 -> invoicing & revenue recognition; #3 -> security/legal signoff; #5 -> prevents billing disputes; #2 -> saves ~10 analyst hours/month; #4 -> reduces first-week support load.

omar_eng: T-shirt estimates (very rough): #1 -> 2 engs x 4-6w (usage pipeline + billing model + export hooks). #3 -> 3 engs x 6-9w (packaging + config for air-gapped installs). #5 -> 1 eng x 2-3w. #2 -> 1 eng x 1-2w. #4 -> 1 designer + 1 eng x 2w.

ryan_pm: Prioritizing by revenue/legal risk: 1 > 3 > 5 > 2 > 4. Can CS offer stopgaps so they don't pause renewal?

emma_cs: We offered a nightly CSV split export and a short signed attestation for pilot compliance. Customer said CSV is clumsy but acceptable for up to 6 weeks if we commit to a roadmap date.

workflow-bot: Created RD-5120: "Sunrise: campaign billing interim export + spike" assigned to @omar_eng.

omar_eng: I'll add an API-only spike in RD-5120 to avoid Console work and try to shorten delivery by ~2w. Will document acceptance criteria and migration steps.

ryan_pm: Please add impact/effort on the roadmap: #1 Impact=9 Effort=8, #3 Impact=8 Effort=9, #5 Impact=6 Effort=3, #2 Impact=5 Effort=2, #4 Impact=4 Effort=2.

zoe_prod: Can CS ask Sunrise to rank their items 1-5 and explicitly confirm CSV interim acceptance? That will help sequencing.

emma_cs: Pinged their procurement & infra leads, asked for ranking + written CSV acceptance by EOD. Will paste their reply here.

omar_eng: If they confirm API-first, we can parallelize the export hooks and not touch Console for the spike.

emma_cs: Sunrise replied: ranking = 1,3,5,2,4. They accept the CSV interim but need a firm commit date within 3 weeks or renewal may be at risk. Renewal risk flagged as "elevated".

ryan_pm: Action items: emma -> get written acceptance and calendar the renewal play; omar -> post spike plan in RD-5120; zoe -> update roadmap. Closing thread until RD-5120 has a spike plan. :white_check_mark:
